content: Predictive scheduling / fair workweek laws: Oregon statewide; 11+ city ordinances (Chicago, NYC, Seattle, SF, Philadelphia, LA, Berkeley, Emeryville, Evanston). Typical: 14-day advance posting, predictability pay for within-window changes, right-to-rest 9-11h between shifts, written good-faith hours estimate at hire. NYC retail is 72h outlier.
